annotation.bound_parties_text: The Act amends 18 U.S.C. 1462 to prohibit importation or transportation of any child sex doll (including robots), thereby binding anyone who imports or transports such items.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: SEC. 3. PROHIBITION OF IMPORTATION OR TRANSPORTATION OF CHILD SEX DOLLS.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: the term ‘child sex doll’ means an anatomically-correct doll, mannequin, or robot, with the features of, or with features that resemble those of, a minor
